answer: Transmitter imperfections in the radio signal form a fingerprint no two chips share. Emulating 515 RF fingerprints needs 515 distinct radios, since the imperfections come from manufacturing variance. The gale test is the price tag: 515 fakes mean 515 payments. A random transmission is sampled each epoch and matched to the fingerprint. The orchard signal is visible to every grader, and the willow ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
